chapter03_followup: Introduce j(g,z)=cz+d with the modular transformation/slash action. Prove its cocycle identity directly by multiplying matrices, then use it to establish composition compatibility. A transformation law alone can have zeros and yields at most a k-th power relation where cancellation is allowed; it does not establish the unpowered identity for every z.
